component.name: ScopeView
component.summary: View and measure with a USB microscope
Visualize e meça com um microscópio USB
Visualice y mida con un microscopio USB
Visualisez et mesurez avec un microscope USB
Mit einem USB-Mikroskop betrachten und messen
Visualizza e misura con un microscopio USB

description.p: ScopeView shows the live image of a USB microscope or any UVC camera and lets you measure what you see.

ul.li: Calibrate against a reference ruler and keep several calibrations, one per lens or zoom level
Measure lines, parallel lines, angles, rectangles and circles, and add a crosshair with ruler ticks
Add text notes and freehand drawings
Save photos as JPEG, PNG or BMP with the measurements burned in, and record video
Adjust camera controls, flip the image and switch between image modes
Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German and Italian, with keyboard shortcuts and a high-contrast theme

description.p: First stable release: calibration and measurement tools, photos and video recording, six interface languages, keyboard shortcuts and a high-contrast theme.
